mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained increase over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over two consecutive months signals increased economic activity and corporate output, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO shows a sustained increase over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening and reduced corporate earnings, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL shows a sustained increase over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 70% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200k and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures combined with an increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening economy, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% and UNRATE increased by more than 0.3% within a month.
